name: kxgdp
title: Will US real GDP growth in Q3 2026 exceed the stated threshold?
settlement: Resolves YES if the BEA's seasonally adjusted and annualized Advance Estimate of real GDP growth for Q3 2026 is strictly greater than the stated threshold (e.g., 4.0%, 3.5%, etc.). Expiration Value is the one-decimal percentage published by the BEA in its Advance Estimate release.
decideContext: Analyst is estimating the likely effect of the news item on the BEA's Q3 2026 Advance Estimate of annualized real GDP growth (a single quarterly percentage figure); market resolves YES if that published figure exceeds the threshold, so assess whether the news pushes expected growth up or down and by roughly how much.
